Name: FarmCave GreenMine
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
This mod has been tested with 1.6.15, respectively SMAPI 4.2.1.0 / Content Patcher 2.6.1 on Windows 10.

This is a mod for the Farm Cave which should work with any farm layout (if you have problems, PLEASE comment so I can fix them).

It adds two exits (elevator doors). The left one will bring up the elevator menu from the mines (it will not work until you have unlocked the elevator or level 5 within the mines). The right one will bring you to your greenhouse (in most cases, this works even if you have not yet unlocked the greenhouse). It also adds some more light.

There is a possibility that your game could crash when you interact with the greenhouse before unlocking it.

Use at your own risk! Make sure to backup your save BEFORE using this. I do not take responsibility if your game crashes or you lose a savegame!

Downloads.Description: This mod adds an exit to the greenhouse, the elevator to the mines and an additional light tile.
